item.title: Tangy Bar-B-Que Sauce
item.description: This BBQ sauce is tangy, but it 's also sweet and has a nice taste of onion and garlic. It coats chicken or beef beautifully and also makes a great sauce to serve in small bowls for dipping.

item.title: Sriracha Aioli
item.description: Sriracha aioli is a deliciously creamy and spicy dipping sauce that's easy to make with just 3 ingredients: mayo, Sriracha, and lime juice.

item.title: Puerto Rican Garlic Marinade
item.description: This Puerto Rican garlic marinade recipe uses only four ingredients-olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper-but gives lots of flavor to any meat.

item.title: Copycat Signature Sauce
item.description: If you love Chick-fil-A's signature sauce, try this easy copycat recipe, which uses only six ingredients, for chicken nuggets or chicken sandwiches.

item.title: Copycat Polynesian Sauce
item.description: Deliciously sweet and sour with a strong tangy flavor, this copycat recipe for Chick-fil-A's Polynesian sauce is perfect to serve with nuggets, tenders, or chicken sandwiches.

item.title: George's Woo Hoo BBQ Sauce
item.description: Molasses, ketchup, and lemon juice are the predominant factors in this quick simmer sauce for your barbeque needs, or when you just need something to make your food go "WOO HOO!"
